== Starting Your Journey ==

{{Checklist|title=Section 1|
* Make a cool character
* Lumbridge Kitchen
** pick up a [[Knife#Item sources|Knife]], 1 [[Jug#Item sources|Jug]] and fill it with water
* Go down the ladder
** pick up 2 Buckets (hop worlds), Cabbage, and Leather Boots
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rune_Mysteries Rune Mysteries] until you've finished talking with the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Duke_Horacio Duke Horacio]
* Top floor of Castle, Right-click light logs to 15 Firemaking, bank 5 Ashes
* Setup 2fa on your account and set a bank pin
* Bank everything, pick up 1 inventory of logs and bank them
* Withdraw a knife, pickup logs and fletch until you have 1815 Arrow Shafts

}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 2|
* withdraw GP, Knife, Mind Runes, Air Runes
* Pickpocket [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Man Men] in front of the Lumbridge Castle until 235 GP
**Die for more HP or pick up cabbages in basement to eat
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lumbridge_General_Store Lumbridge General Store]
** Spade
** Hammer
** Chisel
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/X_Marks_the_Spot X Marks the Spot] until you've [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/X_Marks_the_Spot/Quick_guide#/media/File:X_Marks_the_Spot_-_first_clue.png dug up outside Bob's]

* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Restless_Ghost Restless Ghost] until you've spoken to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Father_Aereck Father Aereck]
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Misthalin_Mystery Misthalin Mystery]
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Restless_Ghost Restless Ghost] until you get a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ghostspeak_amulet Ghostspeak Amulet]
** Pick up Leather Gloves  in the hut
{{Map|name=Chill Ironman Guide PVM Prep|x=3148|y=3177|plane=0|r=4|mapID=0|mtype=square}}
* Get the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Friendly_Forester Forestry Kit] in Draynor Village
* Bank everything except gp
* Train until 20 Agility at the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Draynor_Village_Rooftop_Course Draynor Course]
* Buy 26 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Jug_of_wine Jugs of Wine] from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fortunato Fortunato]

{{Checklist|title=Section 3|
* Clan Wars minigame tele to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ferox_Enclave Clan Wars-Ferox Envclave]
* Restore Run Energy at Pool. Deposit Everything, withdraw 3 wines
* Grab 7 Iron Bars (hop) north-west of Ferox
{{Map|name=Chill Ironman Guide PVM Prep|x=3111|y=3657|plane=0|r=4|mapID=0|mtype=square}}
* Take portal to Soul Wars back in Ferox (Northeast, in cave), then exit the portal to Edgeville
** This is an easy teleport to Edgeville + Energy Restore, use often
* Bank everything
* Run to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barbarian_Village Barbarian Village], pick up 20 Cooked Meat in the Longhall(hop)
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Stronghold_of_Security Stronghold of Security] for 10k
* Take portals out and Bank in Edgeville
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 4|
* withdraw Knife, Jug of Water, Bronze Axe, Tinderbox, Leather Gloves, 5 wines, 1 log
* Equip Leather Gloves & Bronze Axe
* Close to the portal/lever, grab 2 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Nettles Nettles]

* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Trader_Crewmember Charter Trader]

** 7 Buckets of Sand
** 1 Cake Tin
** 1 Glassblowing Pipe

* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sea_Slug Sea Slug]
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lovecraft%27s_Tackle Witchaven Fishing Shop]
** 2 Fishing Rods
** 1 Fly Fishing Rod
** 1 Harpoon
** 1 Lobster Pot
** 10 Fishing Bait
** 1 Raw Sardine

** Keep these on whenever questing

* Sell all but 19 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Silk Silk] back to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Silk_merchant Silk Trader]
